name: distribution-ingress-bind
description: Publisher side. Gateway POST /d/{distribution_id}/bind. Holds the cross-tenancy check that quote-bind structurally cannot: quote-bind is reached by decision_id and has no way to know which distributor asked, so without this a distributor with a valid key for its own path could bind another distributor's quote by naming its id. Also holds bind idempotency on quote_id -- a duplicate bind returns the first outcome, never a second policy, and it decides that BEFORE any counter is touched. config.result names PREPARE_BIND, the last node every branch reaches.
